Class TotemPlacementState

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.controller.states.ControllerState
org.adsl.server.controller.states.TotemPlacementState
All Implemented Interfaces:
RequestVisitor<VirtualClient>
public class TotemPlacementState extends ControllerState
Manual state in which players, in turn-order, place their totem on an offer tile to choose their action for the round.

Players are served in the order they appear on the OrderTile. Each must submit a MoveRequest targeting a free OfferTile slot. Once all players have placed their totems the state transitions to ActionExecutionState.
